title: 장애인·노인·임산부 등의 편의증진 보장에 관한 법률 시행규칙 [별표 2] — 편의시설의 세부설치기준과 대상시설, 항목 "바. 시각장애인용 유도블록" (1)
org: 법제처 국가법령정보센터 (Ministry of Government Legislation, Korea Law Information Center) — enforcement rule under the Act on the Guarantee of Promotion of Convenience of Persons with Disabilities, the Aged, Pregnant Women, etc.
passage: "시각장애인을 유도하기 위한 바닥재료는 유도용 선형블록과 감지용 점형블록을 사용한다. 이 경우 바닥재의 크기는 0.3미터×0.3미터이상의 블록을 사용하여야 한다." (The flooring used to guide visually impaired people is linear guide block and dot-type warning block; the block itself must be at least 0.3m x 0.3m.)
reliability: High — read directly from the law.go.kr-hosted enforcement-rule attachment, primary legal text.

title: 장애인·노인·임산부 등의 편의증진 보장에 관한 법률 시행규칙 [별표 2], 항목 "바. 시각장애인용 유도블록" (4)
passage: "점형블록은 굴절부, 단차부분, 위험장소의 0.3미터 전면에 부설하여야 한다." (Dot-type warning blocks must be laid 0.3m in front of turning points, level changes, and hazard locations — an installation offset in the direction of travel, not a lateral clearance.) The same rule (0.3m in front) is repeated elsewhere in the same 별표 for building entrances and low-service-counter fronts.

title: 보행안전 및 편의증진에 관한 법률 시행규칙 [별표 1] — 보행안전 및 편의증진 시설의 구조 및 기준, 항목 11. 점자블록

passage: Item 11 defines only the tactile block's color (yellow, by default) and the functional purpose of point-type vs. linear blocks. No dimension, distance, or clearance figure of any kind appears in this item.

title: 부록1. 점자블록 (설치 원칙 3)
passage: "선형블록을 중심으로 좌,우 최소 60cm 부근에는 어떠한 장애물도 있어서는 아니 된다." (Centered on the linear block, no obstacle of any kind should exist within at least 60cm on either side.)
reliability: Medium — a credentialed disability-advocacy technical document, but a guideline, not a binding legal source; confirms the concept of a both-sides clearance zone exists in Korean practice, but at 60cm, not 30cm.

title: 선형블록 좌우 60cm 공간 확보로 시각장애인의 안전보장해야!
org: 시각장애인편의시설지원센터 (Support Center for Convenience Facilities for the Visually Impaired)
type: News/advocacy article on organization's own site
passage: "선형 블록 외곽선으로부터 최소 60cm 이내에는 어떠한 장애물도 존재해서는 안 된다" — explicitly framed by the source itself as a recommendation in the Center's own manual, derived by combining the statute's 0.3m pre-hazard offset rule with a separate vehicle-bollard-spacing rule, not as a quotation of existing law.
reliability: High for what it demonstrates: that a 60cm (not 30cm) both-sides figure circulates as an advocacy recommendation explicitly derived from, but not equal to, the statutory 30cm pre-hazard offset — a plausible origin for the conflation in the tested claim.
